description: Calculate the Vimshottari mahadasha periods from a birth chart: the nine periods with start and end dates, which one is running now and how many years remain in it. Requires birth date, birth time and coordinates.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

time.description: Local birth time at the birth place, HH:MM. Required: the dasha balance depends on the Moon's exact position.

name: get_vimshottari_dasha
title: Vimshottari dasha periods
